info.title: BreachSpider correlation API (v1 correlate + v2 Windows patch level)
info.description: Covers POST /api/v1/assets/correlate-cves, /check, and API v2 Windows patch level. Full docs: https://breachspider.com/docs/api/correlate/ and https://breachspider.com/docs/api/windows-patch/. Per-key rate limit: 60 requests and 5,000 assets/hosts per minute by default (429 with error.detail.retry_after). Behavior change 2026-09-26: cves[] defaults to priority order; use options.sort=score for the previous order.

bearerAuth.description: bs_live_ API key. v2 submissions need the write scope.

code.description: General code, e.g. AUTH_REQUIRED, VALIDATION_ERROR, RATE_LIMITED, UNKNOWN_PARAMETER.

detail.description: Specific error: for v2 an object with error, message and extra fields such as retry_after; for validation errors a list of {field, message, type}.

derived.description: true when taken from the affected version range, not a vendor fix statement

fix.description: The action, e.g. 'upgrade beyond 3.11', 'install KB5122876 (latest cumulative, build 10.0.17763.9245)', 'ESU required (or upgrade the OS)', 'no fix known'.

cve_ids.description: CVEs this action clears, in priority order.

kbs_covered.description: Windows only: the per-CVE KBs this action supersedes.

note.description: Present on every derived step: derived from affected version ranges; confirm the target release in the vendor's advisory, as it may not exist in this product line.

asset_id.description: Your identifier, echoed. Use a non-identifying id.

anyOf.description: Software or firmware version used for matching.
Used for matching when version is empty (warning VERSION_FROM_FIRMWARE).

include_capec.description: Default false for API keys (true in the web app).

sort.description: Order of each asset's cves[], applied before paging. priority: confirmed -> known-exploited -> exploit/PoC -> fix (installable, then ESU-required, then none) -> BCS -> CVSS -> EPSS. score: the previous order. exploit: KEV -> exploit/PoC -> EPSS -> CVSS. newest: published date. Any other value -> 422.

confirmed_only.description: Only CVEs confirmed for the supplied version / confirmed open.

known_exploited_only.description: Only CVEs on the CISA KEV catalog.

fix_available_only.description: Only CVEs with a known fix (stored, derived, KB or ESU).

200.description: Per-asset resolution, ranked CVEs, fix groups and plan

cves.title: The affected product lacks an authentication check when sending commands to the server via the Moxa service. This vulner
cves.description: The affected product lacks an authentication check when sending commands to the server via the Moxa service. This vulnerability allows an attacker to execute specified commands, potentially leading to unauthorized downloads or uploads of configuration files and system compromise.

sage.executive_summary: CVE-2024-9137 affects Moxa products due to a lack of authentication checks when sending commands to the server via the Moxa service. This can lead to unauthorized command execution, potentially allowing attackers to download or upload configuration files and compromise the system. The CVSS score is 9.4, indicating a high severity level.

cves.title: Multiple switches are affected by an out-of-bounds write vulnerability. This vulnerability is caused by insufficient inp
cves.description: Multiple switches are affected by an out-of-bounds write vulnerability. This vulnerability is caused by insufficient input validation, which allows data to be written to memory outside the bounds of the buffer. Successful exploitation of this vulnerability could result in a denial-of-service attack.

sage.executive_summary: Multiple switches are affected by an out-of-bounds write vulnerability due to insufficient input validation, which could lead to a denial-of-service attack.

cves.title: This vulnerability could lead to denial-of-service or service crashes. Exploitation of the moxa_cmd service, because of
cves.description: This vulnerability could lead to denial-of-service or service crashes. Exploitation of the moxa_cmd service, because of insufficient input validation, allows attackers to disrupt operations. If exposed to public networks, the vulnerability poses a significant remote threat, potentially allowing attackers to shut down affected systems.

sage.executive_summary: CVE-2024-9404 is a vulnerability in the moxa_cmd service due to insufficient input validation, which could lead to denial-of-service or service crashes. This poses a significant remote threat if exposed to public networks.

post.summary: Submit Windows hosts (JSON) and get per-CVE patch status
post.description: Requires the write scope. Hosts are validated individually; refused hosts are listed in data.rejected and nothing from them is stored. Returns 422 with the same body shape when every host is refused.
